data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my recommendation would be **Stripe for most businesses**, with Shopify Payments or Square potentially being better depending on how your store is built.

The best option isn't necessarily the one with the lowest transaction fee. Ease of integration, customer checkout experience, reliability and payout speed matter too.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- UK card fees: 1.5% + 20p
- No monthly fee on standard pricing
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and card payments
- Excellent integrations and subscription support

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and independent online stores.

[Stripe UK pricing](https://stripe.com/GB/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No need for a separate payment gateway
- Simplifies refunds and order management
- Rates depend on your Shopify subscription

My recommendation if you're already using Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Online UK card fees: 1.4% + 25p
- Free basic online store options
- Good inventory management
- Excellent if you also sell in person

[Square online payments](https://squareup.com/gb/en/payments/online-payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Familiar to many online shoppers
- Offers card and PayPal account payments
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms
- Standard commercial transaction rate generally 2.9% + fixed fee

Good as an additional payment option rather than necessarily your only processor.

[PayPal UK fees](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![GreenTheUK | Conservation and Restoration Projects on Land and Sea](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/GpMWPKmQS0ivwb-vUrMJkoXbMY1YHqZLwczazSCgdTNcSpJToMo9TAxWp3DhHLau7K-m_pvzIgRa052-pcyd7VM-LR612mPLmmz7ttDEvyaNHcIuOSULexyB1JDi6PwpQQWkWRqgJ1D4MJL-DyzM2xMQWnSpYE5tgYRB8SsU_jbXzNUfVx_kjgv1l2qMxiZs?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. GoCardless**

- Direct Debit rather than ordinary card processing
- Particularly useful for recurring payments
- Standard pricing around 1% + 20p, subject to caps and terms

Best for memberships, subscriptions and regular payments.

[GoCardless website](https://gocardless.com/)

These are UK standard pricing examples checked against current published information; premium and international cards can cost more. ## What would I choose?

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| General small online store | Stripe |
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| Online and physical shop | Square |
| Customers who prefer PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Monthly subscriptions | Stripe or GoCardless |


## Three questions to narrow it down

I can recommend the most cost-effective option if I know a little about your business.
